text: hm. so its working much better now. but it doesnt show up on shapes like [Image #7]
resolution: The paint grid only rendered on axis-aligned quads — the overlay used a 4-corner bilerp, so angled panels and triangular/n-gon faces (windshield, sloped body) showed no grid and no cursor cell. Replaced the bilerp with uvToWorld: a barycentric map over the face's fan triangulation that turns any atlas-UV point into a world point ON the face, for ANY shape. Grid lines are sampled at the integer-texel boundaries (the req_1219 alignment) and clipped to the face's UV hull so a triangle's lines stop at its edges; the cursor cell + centre dot map through the same function. Painting itself already worked on these faces (the raycast is per-triangle) — this restores the missing visual feedback. meshPaint 7/7 (+uvToWorld covering quad + triangle), Studio bundles clean, hot-reload.
